name: defaults
body:
Range("H1").ClearContents
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(8, 0, 0, 90, 30)
sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"

Err.Clear
p = CStr(sh.ControlFormat.LargeChange)
If Err.Number <> 0 Then p = "error" & CStr(Err.Number)

Report = CStr(n) & "|" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & "|" & _
